descriptionFull: The yellow-crowned night heron ( Nyctanassa violacea , formerly in the genus Nycticorax ), is one of two species of night herons found in the Americas, the other one being the black-crowned night heron. It is known as the Bihoreau Violacé in French and the Pedrete Corona Clara in Spanish.
